note: Source of truth for the IP style library. 36 styles across 8 families. All descriptors are generic visual language - no artist names, no studio names, no trademarked character names (see references/naming-and-brand-safety.md).

families.blurb: Silhouette-first, personality-first characters built for instant recognition.
Rendered-as-an-object characters with material identity and studio lighting.
Grid-, facet- and cube-quantised characters with retro-game DNA.
Fibre-and-fabric characters that sell as merchandise.
Line-and-tone illustrated characters with expressive acting.
Non-human things turned into characters - the highest-viral-potential lane.
Presenter-grade characters for talking-head, VTuber and live-commerce use.

styles.tagline_en: Two-tone bean-shaped character with no limbs - readable at 32 pixels.
styles.tagline_zh: 两色豆形、无四肢，缩到32像素依然认得出。
use_when: Sub-brand or sub-topic mascot in a channel with several series
styles.avoid_when: The character needs hands, gestures or props - a blob cannot hold anything convincingly.
styles.proportion: single rounded mass, 1 head, no neck, no limbs, optional stub arms
styles.surface: flat matte fill with one flat shadow shape, optional soft inner glow
styles.lighting: flat, no cast shadow, or a single soft drop shadow
styles.core_en: a simple bean-shaped mascot character, single rounded body with no limbs, two-tone flat colour blocking, one large expressive eye pair, thick even outline, minimal interior detail, generous negative space, centred icon composition
styles.video: Fastest lane for reaction cutaways - one shape, one colour swap per beat.
styles.loop: Squash-and-stretch bob with a 6-8 frame ease, or a 2-frame colour blink.

styles.tagline_en: Two-head-tall deformed character, oversized eyes, tiny limbs, maximum cute.
styles.tagline_zh: 两头身变形比例，眼睛占脸一半，小短肢，萌度拉满。
styles.avoid_when: You need believable action or walking - chibi bodies break fast at full-body motion.
styles.proportion: head-to-body 1:2 to 1:2.5, head 50-60% of total height, hands mitten-shaped with no fingers
styles.surface: clean gradient or cel shading, blush circles on cheeks
styles.lighting: soft frontal key, gentle rim, low contrast
styles.core_en: a chibi character in two-head proportions, oversized round head, huge glossy eyes with layered highlights, tiny simplified body, mitten hands without fingers, thick clean anime linework, soft cel shading, blush circles on the cheeks, bright saturated palette
styles.video: Huge emotional range in a small body - the cheapest way to show reaction without dialogue.
styles.loop: Idle breathing bob + occasional 2-frame blink; or a 1-second jump with anticipation squash.

styles.tagline_en: Upright animal in clothing, with clear human gesture and animal surface cues.
styles.tagline_zh: 直立动物穿衣服，既有人类手势又保留动物表面特征。
use_when: Food, travel, pet and education channels
styles.avoid_when: The species has a silhouette too similar to a competitor mascot in the same niche.
styles.proportion: 1:3 to 1:3.5 head-to-body, upright bipedal stance, hands with 3-4 simplified fingers
styles.surface: fur or feather directional strokes over flat colour, fabric clothing with fold lines
styles.lighting: soft studio key, subtle ambient occlusion where limbs meet body
styles.core_en: an upright anthropomorphic animal mascot standing on two legs, wearing a simple outfit, animal surface texture with directional fur strokes, simplified expressive face with a small snout and large eyes, readable hand gestures, thick even outline, full body visible
styles.video: The most buildable costume IP - walks, waves and points read instantly.
styles.loop: Wave cycle (arm up, wrist sway 2x, arm down) is the canonical mascot loop.

styles.tagline_en: Chunky, loud, competitive character built for badges, jerseys and hype.
styles.tagline_zh: 厚重、大嗓门、好胜，为队徽/球衣/氛围而生。
use_when: Sports, esports, fitness and gaming channels
Team identity that needs a rival-antagonist
styles.avoid_when: The brand position is calm, premium or clinical.
styles.proportion: 1:2.5 to 1:3, oversized head and hands, heavy feet, exaggerated jaw
styles.surface: hard cel shading with thick black outline, jersey fabric, number and badge
styles.lighting: high-contrast hard key from upper left, graphic shadow shapes
styles.core_en: a retro sports mascot character, chunky athletic build with an oversized head and big gloved hands, thick black outline with hard cel shading, team jersey with a number, confident wide stance, energetic open-mouth expression, bold two-tone team palette
styles.video: Built for 3-second hype cuts - fist pump, roar, point at camera.
styles.loop: Shoulder-bounce idle with a pumping arm, 12-16 frames, on a 2-second cycle.

styles.tagline_en: Neatly proportioned, non-threatening character designed for merch and onboarding.
styles.tagline_zh: 比例端正、不吓人，为周边与新手引导设计的角色。
use_when: Brand that must read as trustworthy and warm
styles.avoid_when: You want an underground or anti-corporate persona.
styles.proportion: 1:3.5 to 1:4, clean balanced limbs, rounded hands, stable stance
styles.surface: soft flat shading, minimal texture, one signature colour accent
styles.lighting: even soft light, very low shadow contrast, bright cheerful value range
styles.core_en: a friendly brand mascot character, clean balanced proportions, soft rounded shapes, warm approachable facial expression with a small open smile, neat simple clothing with one signature colour accent, flat soft shading with clean rounded forms, symmetrical front-facing pose, high readability at small sizes
styles.video: The safest presenter-adjacent character - can hold a sign, a product, a chart.
styles.loop: Slow friendly wave + a 2-frame nod, 24 frames, 2-second seamless cycle.

styles.tagline_en: Matte, subsurface-lit 3D character on a pastel gradient backdrop.
styles.tagline_zh: 哑光次表面散射的3D角色，柔和渐变背景。
use_when: The default modern IP look on TikTok / Reels
styles.avoid_when: You need a hand-drawn, human-made feel.
styles.proportion: 1:2.5 to 1:3, smooth organic volumes, no sharp corners
styles.surface: matte dielectric material, soft subsurface scattering, fine surface noise, subtle roughness map variation
styles.lighting: large softbox key from upper front, fill from the side, gentle rim, pastel gradient background
styles.core_en: a soft matte 3D rendered character, rounded organic volumes with smooth transitions between forms, matte dielectric material with subtle subsurface scattering, soft large-area key light from upper front, gentle rim light, pastel gradient studio backdrop, shallow depth of field, clean product-render quality, no harsh specular hotspots
styles.video: The most forgiving style for image-to-video - soft lighting survives motion artefacts well.
styles.loop: Slow 360-degree turntable or a 3-key idle (breathe, look around, blink).

styles.tagline_en: Glossy collectible figure with a seam line and a display base.
styles.tagline_zh: 高光搪胶潮玩，带注塑接缝与展示底座。
styles.avoid_when: You want the character to feel soft and approachable rather than collectible.
styles.proportion: 1:3 to 1:3.5, large head, compact body, small feet on a round base
styles.surface: high-gloss vinyl, visible parting seam, subtle orange-peel texture, painted facial features
styles.lighting: two-point hard studio lighting with crisp specular rolls, dark gradient background
styles.core_en: a glossy designer vinyl figure, large rounded head with a compact body, smooth injection-moulded surface with a visible parting seam line, high-gloss reflective vinyl with crisp specular highlights, painted-on facial features, standing on a round display base, two-point studio lighting against a dark gradient background, collectible product photography
styles.video: Turntable reveals and light-sweep shots are the native format of this style.
styles.loop: Slow 20-degree rotation with a moving specular sweep - hypnotic and seamless.

styles.tagline_en: Hand-pressed modelling-clay character with fingerprints and matte softness.
styles.tagline_zh: 手捏黏土角色，带指纹与哑光柔和感。
styles.avoid_when: The channel needs a sleek, premium or high-tech tone.
styles.proportion: asymmetric and hand-made, 1:2.5 to 1:4, deliberately uneven
styles.surface: matte plasticine with thumbprints, tool marks, slight surface irregularity, visible seams where parts join
styles.lighting: soft diffuse light, gentle contact shadow, muted background
styles.core_en: a hand-pressed modelling clay character, matte plasticine surface with visible thumbprints and tool marks, slightly uneven hand-made proportions, parts joined with visible seams, soft diffuse lighting with a gentle contact shadow, muted warm background, shallow depth of field, stop-motion craft aesthetic
styles.video: Perfect for clay-hyperlapse content; the material sells 'made by hand'.
styles.loop: Gentle breathing with a slow head tilt, 24 frames, slight clay wobble on each keyframe.

styles.tagline_en: Folded-cardstock character with visible creases and real paper grain.
styles.tagline_zh: 卡纸折成的立体角色， crease 与纸纹清晰可见。
use_when: Craft, DIY, school and kids content
Environments built entirely from the same material logic
styles.proportion: angular and fold-based, 1:3, limbs as folded paper tabs
styles.surface: matte cardstock with visible fold creases, paper grain, cut-edge highlight, layered paper edges
styles.lighting: single directional light casting crisp folded-paper shadows, warm neutral backdrop
styles.core_en: a three-dimensional paper craft character, folded and layered cardstock construction, visible crisp fold creases and cut edges, matte uncoated paper grain texture, flat colour faces with subtle paper sheen, limbs made from folded paper tabs, single directional light casting defined folded-paper shadows, warm neutral backdrop, craft studio aesthetic
styles.video: Paper characters justify simple hinge-joint motion; creases read as 'real paper' in motion.
styles.loop: Flat 2-frame flap animation reads as authentic paper puppetry.

styles.tagline_en: Translucent resin character with suspended glitter and a glossy dome.
styles.tagline_zh: 半透明树脂角色，内部封存闪片，表面高光罩面。
styles.avoid_when: The character needs to read clearly at small sizes on a busy feed.
styles.proportion: 1:3, elongated elegant forms, small head, decorative base
styles.surface: semi-translucent cast resin, internal bubble and glitter inclusions, glass-like gloss topcoat
styles.lighting: backlight plus rim to exploit translucency, dark or gradient background
styles.core_en: a translucent cast resin art figure, semi-transparent resin body with suspended glitter flecks and tiny internal bubbles, glass-like glossy topcoat, soft internal light scattering, decorative base, backlit rim lighting against a dark gradient background, macro detail on inclusions, jewellery-grade product rendering
styles.video: Slow light-through-body shots; use for ASMR and reveal moments.
styles.loop: Very slow shimmer with a moving backlight, 48+ frames on a 4-second cycle.

styles.tagline_en: Geometric, gradient-free illustration with confident shape language.
styles.tagline_zh: 几何化、无渐变的扁平插画，形状语言自信。
use_when: Brand systems needing a scalable vector identity
Fast iteration on many character variants
styles.avoid_when: You need soft, tactile or emotional warmth.
styles.proportion: 1:3 to 1:4, simplified geometry, consistent stroke weight
styles.surface: pure flat colour, no texture, at most one darker shade per hue for shadow
styles.lighting: no realistic lighting; optional single long flat shadow shape
styles.core_en: a flat vector illustration character, simplified geometric construction of circles, capsules and rounded rectangles, pure flat colour fills with no gradients, consistent line weight, minimal internal detail, clean modern editorial illustration style, balanced negative space, crisp vector-sharp edges
styles.video: Cheapest to animate - shape morphs and colour swaps only, no shading redraw.
styles.loop: Morph between two key poses on a matching outline, 12 frames.

styles.tagline_en: Printed-sticker character with a white cut border and slight gloss.
styles.tagline_zh: 模切白边加轻微光泽的印刷贴纸角色。
styles.avoid_when: You need a character that lives in a 3D scene.
styles.proportion: 1:3, compact and centred so the cut border is even all round
styles.surface: glossy laminated print, slight edge highlight, subtle surface reflection
styles.lighting: flat print lighting plus one thin specular band across the top
styles.core_en: a die-cut vinyl sticker character, bold cartoon shapes with an even white cut border around the entire silhouette, glossy laminated print finish with a subtle specular band, saturated spot colours, slight edge highlight, presented flat against a plain background, merchandise sticker product shot
styles.video: The native unit of sticker-reaction edits - drop-in overlay with a pop-in scale.
styles.loop: 3-frame pop-in scale from 0 to 105% to 100%, then hold.

styles.tagline_en: Single-weight outline character with no fill - pure shape economy.
styles.tagline_zh: 单线宽轮廓、无填色的极简线稿，形状极简。
use_when: When the brand colour comes from the background, not the character
styles.avoid_when: The feed is visually busy and you need to punch through.
styles.proportion: 1:3.5 to 1:4, minimal interior detail, one continuous gesture per shape
styles.surface: single-weight ink line on flat background, no fill, no shading
styles.lighting: none; pure line on flat colour or white
styles.core_en: a minimal single-weight line art character, one confident even line describing each form, no fill and no shading, minimal interior detail, calm generous negative space, elegant editorial line work, high contrast against a flat background, minimalist design aesthetic
styles.video: Best as a motion-graphics asset - the line draws itself on, then the fill wipes in.
styles.loop: On-stroke draw-on cycle (8 frames) with a fill wipe; seamless when the path closes.

styles.tagline_en: Squiggles, dots and terrazzo - loud, playful, 1980s-90s energy.
styles.tagline_zh: 波浪线、圆点与水磨石纹，吵闹好玩，八九十年代气质。
use_when: Loud, high-energy channels that need visual noise
styles.avoid_when: The channel is calm, luxury or documentary in tone.
styles.proportion: 1:2.5 to 1:3, energetic asymmetry, tilted baselines
styles.surface: flat high-chroma colour with black squiggle outlines, confetti and terrazzo speckle
styles.lighting: none; pure graphic colour
styles.core_en: a playful character in a bold 1980s-1990s graphic style, high-chroma flat colour palette, thick black outline, hand-drawn squiggle and wavy line decorations, scattered confetti dots and confetti shapes, terrazzo speckle pattern, geometric shapes and triangles floating around the character, tilted dynamic composition, energetic and loud graphic design
styles.video: Every element can pop, rotate or slide independently - built for busy motion graphics.
styles.loop: Element-by-element pop-in sequence, 8-12 frames, resetting seamlessly.

styles.tagline_en: Character assembled from a few primitives - maximum brand scalability.
styles.tagline_zh: 只用几个基本几何形拼成的角色，扩展性极强。
use_when: Spin-off character families from one template
Logo-adjacent characters that must stay iconic
styles.avoid_when: The character needs organic believability or warmth.
styles.proportion: primitive-driven, 1:2.5, limbs as capsules, head as circle or rounded square
styles.surface: flat colour with one consistent accent, perfectly consistent geometry
styles.lighting: flat; optional single offset shadow shape for depth
styles.core_en: a character built entirely from simple geometric primitives, circular head, capsule limbs and rounded rectangular torso, perfectly consistent geometry and stroke weight, flat colour blocks with one signature accent colour, minimal facial features made from two dots and one curve, clean modern tech-brand illustration, centred symmetrical composition
styles.video: Swap colours and accessories to make variant characters for series and collabs.
styles.loop: Simple rotation on the Y axis, or an accessory-swap cycle.

styles.tagline_en: 32x32-grid character on a strict four-colour palette.
styles.tagline_zh: 严格32×32网格、四色色板的像素角色。
styles.avoid_when: The brand must look modern and premium.
styles.proportion: 1:3, chunky blocky silhouette readable at low resolution
styles.surface: hard pixel edges, no anti-aliasing, ordered dithering for gradients, strict 4-colour palette
styles.lighting: quantised into 2-3 discrete light bands
styles.core_en: an 8-bit pixel art character sprite, strict 32 by 32 pixel grid, hard pixel edges with no anti-aliasing, limited four colour palette with ordered dithering, blocky readable silhouette, quantised lighting into flat bands, transparent background, classic 1980s-1990s console game sprite aesthetic
styles.video: Idle animations are classic 4-frame loops; perfect for looping GIF reactions.
styles.loop: Canonical 4-frame walk or bob cycle; seamless by design.

styles.tagline_en: Deeper 16-bit sprite with layered shading and richer costume detail.
styles.tagline_zh: 层次更丰富的16位精灵，阴影与服装细节更足。
use_when: Character stat, skill and lore graphics
styles.avoid_when: You need a modern clean look.
styles.proportion: 1:3.5 to 1:4, more anatomical detail than 8-bit
styles.surface: pixel art with multi-step shading ramps, sprite outlines, dithered gradients, occasional animation frames
styles.lighting: 3-step shading ramp per material, strong key from upper left
styles.core_en: a detailed 16-bit pixel art character sprite, larger pixel grid with multi-step shading ramps, layered costume and armour detail, crisp sprite outline, dithered gradient transitions, strong upper-left key light, three-quarter view, classic 1990s console RPG character sprite, transparent background
styles.video: Attack and idle animation sets are the native asset type here.
styles.loop: 12-16 frame idle cycle with hair and cape secondary motion.

styles.tagline_en: Faceted flat-shaded 3D character built from visible triangles.
styles.tagline_zh: 三角面清晰可见的平面着色3D角色。
use_when: Tech, crypto, gaming and data channels
styles.avoid_when: The character must read as cute and cuddly.
styles.proportion: 1:3, angular and simplified, deliberately coarse facets
styles.surface: flat-shaded triangular facets, hard facet edges, no texture maps
styles.lighting: single directional key with hard facet-to-facet value steps
styles.core_en: a low-poly three-dimensional character, visible triangular facets with flat shading, hard facet edges and no texture maps, simplified angular anatomy, single directional key light creating stepped value changes across facets, limited palette with one accent colour, isometric or three-quarter view, clean geometric 3D aesthetic
styles.video: Cheap to animate because facet counts are low; rotation reads smoothly.
styles.loop: Slow constant Y-axis rotation; lighting steps animate beautifully.

styles.tagline_en: Cube-assembled character in an isometric block world.
styles.tagline_zh: 由立方体拼成的角色，置于等距方块世界中。
use_when: Environments where the character interacts with blocks
styles.avoid_when: The aesthetic must be soft, organic or hand-made.
styles.proportion: 1:3 blocky mass with cubic limbs
styles.surface: cubic voxels on a strict grid, nearest-neighbour sampling, no filters
styles.lighting: directional voxel lighting with baked shadow blocks
styles.core_en: a voxel art character built from small cubes on a strict grid, blocky cubic construction, isometric three-quarter view, nearest-neighbour sampling with sharp pixel edges, voxel-based directional lighting with baked shadow cubes, limited palette, blocky sandbox environment
styles.video: Stepped walk cycles fit naturally; blocky animation has charm.
styles.loop: Alternating limb-step cycle, 8 frames, seamless.

styles.tagline_en: Needle-felted wool character with fuzzy matte fibres and visible stitching.
styles.tagline_zh: 羊毛毡戳刺角色，绒面哑光，缝线可见。
use_when: Merchandise that must feel warm and real
styles.avoid_when: The channel tone is sharp, techy or comedic-fast.
styles.proportion: soft rounded 1:3, slightly squashed and imperfect, no sharp points
styles.surface: matte wool felt with visible individual fibres, needle-felted fuzz, stitched seam details, embroidered facial features
styles.lighting: soft diffused light with gentle fuzzy shadow, muted warm palette
styles.core_en: a hand-made needle-felted wool character, fuzzy matte wool surface with visible individual fibres, soft rounded squashed proportions with handmade imperfection, embroidered facial features and visible stitched seams, soft diffused lighting with gentle fuzzy shadows, muted warm natural palette, cosy handcraft studio aesthetic
styles.video: Slow, tactile movement suits ASMR and calm content.
styles.loop: Gentle breathing with a 2-frame fibre-light shimmer; very slow cycles.

styles.tagline_en: Sewn cloth body with a centre seam, cotton puffiness and button eyes.
styles.tagline_zh: 布质身体带中缝线，棉质蓬松，纽扣眼睛。
styles.avoid_when: The character must look tough, sleek or futuristic.
styles.proportion: 1:3 to 1:3.5, soft rounded limbs, slightly slumped posture
styles.surface: matte woven cotton with visible weave, centre seam line, cotton-stuffing puffiness, button or stitched eyes
styles.lighting: warm soft light, gentle contact shadow, cosy interior feel
styles.core_en: a sewn stuffed fabric doll character, soft cotton body with a visible centre seam line, matte woven fabric texture, cotton-stuffing puffiness, button eyes and stitched mouth, rounded simple limbs slightly slumped in posture, warm soft lighting with gentle contact shadows, cosy homely interior background, handmade textile craft aesthetic
styles.video: Squish-and-squeeze deformation is the character's signature move.
styles.loop: Squash and stretch with a slow release, 16 frames.

styles.tagline_en: Crocheted yarn character with visible stitch loops and loose strands.
styles.tagline_zh: 钩针编织角色，线圈与散线清晰可见。
styles.avoid_when: You need a modern, sharp or high-tech look.
styles.proportion: 1:2.5 to 1:3, exaggerated round head, small nub limbs
styles.surface: yarn with visible crochet stitch loops, fibre twist detail, loose yarn ends
styles.lighting: warm soft light emphasising fibre texture, shallow depth of field
styles.core_en: a hand-crocheted amigurumi yarn character, visible crochet stitch loops and yarn twist detail, exaggerated round head with small nub limbs, yarn texture with loose yarn strand ends, warm soft light emphasising fibre texture, muted cosy palette, shallow depth of field, handmade yarn craft aesthetic
styles.video: Time-lapse stitch-count content is the native format.
styles.loop: Gentle wobble with a loose yarn strand swaying, 20 frames.

styles.tagline_en: Patchwork and button folk-art character with visible hand stitching.
styles.tagline_zh: 拼布与纽扣的手作民俗风角色，针脚可见。
styles.avoid_when: The channel needs a uniform, scalable visual system.
styles.proportion: 1:3, slightly asymmetrical by design, mixed-material limbs
styles.surface: patchwork fabric panels, visible hand stitching, button joints, mixed textures and prints
styles.lighting: warm directional light with soft shadow, natural fabric palette
styles.core_en: a patchwork fabric folk-art character, mismatched textile panels sewn together, visible hand stitching and button joints, mixed material textures including linen, cotton and knitted sections, warm earthy natural palette, asymmetrical deliberately handmade construction, warm directional lighting with soft shadows, traditional craft studio setting
styles.video: Every character can carry a story - good for lore-led series.
styles.loop: Rag-doll style limp arm wave, 16 frames.

styles.tagline_en: Clean lineart, two-tone cel shadow, large expressive eyes.
styles.tagline_zh: 干净线稿、两阶赛璐璐阴影，眼睛大而有表现力。
use_when: Fans who expect a specific anime read
styles.avoid_when: The brand must stay far from anime aesthetics.
styles.proportion: 1:6 to 1:7, anatomically plausible but stylised
styles.surface: clean lineart with consistent weight, two-tone cel shadow, sharp terminator line, flat local colour
styles.lighting: single hard key producing one clean shadow shape, optional rim light
styles.core_en: a cel-shaded anime character, clean confident lineart with consistent weight, large expressive eyes with layered specular highlights and gradient irises, two-tone hard cel shading with a crisp terminator line, flat saturated local colour, a single light source with an optional rim light, full colour anime illustration, transparent or simple gradient background
styles.video: Full acting range - the style supports real emotional performance.
styles.loop: 12-frame idle with hair and cloth secondary motion, then a blink.

styles.tagline_en: Three-head-tall anime deformation with sparkle FX and pastel colour.
styles.tagline_zh: 三头身的动漫变形，配闪光特效与粉彩配色。
use_when: Anime fan channels and kawaii aesthetics
styles.avoid_when: The channel is serious, documentary or instructional.
styles.proportion: head-to-body 1:3, huge eyes, tiny body, simplified hands
styles.surface: clean anime lineart, soft gradient shading, sparkles and star FX, blush
styles.lighting: bright even key, low contrast, high-key pastel palette
styles.core_en: a cute chibi anime character in three-head proportions, oversized head with huge sparkling anime eyes, tiny simplified body, soft pastel gradient shading, clean light lineart, blush circles on the cheeks, sparkle and star-shaped highlight effects, high-key bright lighting, kawaii character illustration
styles.video: Built for oversized reaction pops and FX-heavy comedy beats.
styles.loop: Two-frame bob with sparkle twinkle, 8 frames.

styles.tagline_en: Pure ink linework with screentone dots, panel borders and speed lines.
styles.tagline_zh: 纯墨线加网点纸、边框与速度线。
use_when: Explaining a sequence or a process visually
styles.avoid_when: The brand needs warmth, colour and friendliness.
styles.proportion: 1:7, real anatomy rendered in ink only
styles.surface: black ink on white, screentone dot shading, hatching, cross-hatching, no colour
styles.lighting: implied entirely through tone density and hatching
styles.core_en: a black ink manga illustration, confident tapered brush linework on white paper, screentone dot shading and cross-hatching for tone, bold panel border, dynamic speed lines and dramatic negative space, no colour, high contrast monochrome, expressive pose and exaggerated perspective for impact
styles.video: Panel-by-panel reveal is the native editing unit; ideal for story content.
styles.loop: Line-draw-on cycle frame by frame, matching the panel-reveal edit.

styles.tagline_en: Wet-edged washes with pigment granulation on textured cold-press paper.
styles.tagline_zh: 湿边水彩色块，颜料颗粒沉积在冷压纸上。
styles.avoid_when: You need punch, contrast or high saturation.
styles.proportion: 1:4 to 1:5, loose drawn proportions with visible pencil underdrawing
styles.surface: transparent watercolour washes, hard and soft wet edges, granulation, backruns, visible paper texture and pencil ghost lines
styles.lighting: implied through wash density and reserved white paper
styles.core_en: a watercolour storybook character illustration, transparent watercolour washes with soft wet edges and darker hard edges, visible pigment granulation and paper texture in the cold-press paper, delicate pencil underdrawing still visible, reserved white paper for highlights, limited loose palette of three to four pigments, loose painterly brushwork with bleeding colour, charming hand-painted children's book aesthetic
styles.video: Paint-on-time-lapse reveal matches the style perfectly.
styles.loop: Wash bloom cycle - pigment spreading then settling, 30 frames.

styles.tagline_en: Thick palette-knife paint with visible ridges and deep, saturated darks.
styles.tagline_zh: 厚涂油画，刀痕肌理明显，暗部浓郁饱和。
styles.avoid_when: The content is fast, cute or mass-market.
styles.proportion: 1:4 to 1:5, weighty sculptural form
styles.surface: thick oil paint with visible palette-knife ridges, impasto peaks, loaded darks, broken colour in the lights
styles.lighting: single strong warm key with deep cool shadow mass
styles.core_en: an oil impasto painting of a character, thickly loaded oil paint with visible palette knife ridges and impasto peaks, sculptural paint handling with defined edges, rich deep saturated darks and broken colour in the highlights, strong single warm key light with a cool shadow mass, gallery canvas texture visible, classical painterly oil painting technique
styles.video: Slow camera moves over a still painting; add parallax for life.
styles.loop: Brushstroke sweep across the canvas, 24 frames, seamless if it exits as it enters.

styles.tagline_en: A food item given a face and posture - the highest viral-reach lane.
styles.tagline_zh: 给食物加表情与姿态，传播潜力最高的一类。
use_when: Food review, recipe and cooking channels
styles.avoid_when: The channel is a serious news or corporate brand.
styles.proportion: the food item's own silhouette, roughly 1:1 to 1:2, minimal limbs
styles.surface: render the food's true surface, then add simple eyes, a mouth and optional stub arms
styles.lighting: food-photography key light, appetising specular on the food surface
styles.core_en: an anthropomorphic food character, the food item itself rendered with appetising realistic surface texture and colour, simple expressive cartoon eyes and a mouth placed directly on the food, small stub arms and legs in a confident standing pose, food photography lighting with appetising specular highlights, styled on a clean kitchen surface, playful character design
styles.video: Highest replay and share potential - each dish becomes a recurring cast member.

styles.tagline_en: An everyday object given a personality through face placement and posture.
styles.tagline_zh: 日常物件通过五官位置与姿态获得人格。
styles.avoid_when: The object needs to stay anonymous and unbranded.
styles.proportion: the object's real proportions, 1:1 to 1:2, face placed at the most expressive end
styles.surface: true-to-material surface, matte or glossy as appropriate, wear and fingerprints left in
styles.lighting: product-photography lighting, soft key with a controlled gradient backdrop
styles.core_en: an anthropomorphic everyday object character, the object rendered with true-to-life material and surface detail, expressive cartoon eyes and mouth positioned at the most characterful end of the form, small simplified limbs or a confident standing posture, product photography lighting with soft key light and a controlled gradient backdrop, subtle fingerprints and wear for realism, witty character design
styles.video: Excellent for POV skits - the camera becomes the character's partner.
styles.loop: Slight lean and a two-frame nod, or a slow inspection tilt.

styles.tagline_en: A potted plant with a pot body and petal or leaf hair.
styles.tagline_zh: 花盆做身体，花瓣或叶子做头发。
styles.avoid_when: The channel is fast, aggressive or technical.
styles.proportion: pot as body roughly 1:2, foliage as oversized hair, small arms from the pot rim
styles.surface: matte terracotta or ceramic, real leaf veining, visible soil texture
styles.lighting: warm natural daylight with soft window shadow, botanical styling
styles.core_en: an anthropomorphic potted plant character, terracotta pot as the body with a simple expressive face, large lush foliage and leaves forming the character's hair, real botanical leaf veining and soil texture, small simple arms growing from the pot rim, warm natural window light with soft botanical shadows, calm neutral studio styling, gentle plant-care aesthetic
styles.video: Perfect for 'growth' narratives - sprout-to-flower progression.
styles.loop: Slow leaf sway with a gentle breathing pot, 24 frames.

styles.tagline_en: A single body part as the entire character - surreal, funny, memorable.
styles.tagline_zh: 用单一身体部位做成整个角色，超现实又搞笑。
use_when: Medical, dental, fitness and wellness topics
Surreal-brand channels wanting a talking hook
styles.avoid_when: The subject is sensitive, clinical or distressing.
styles.proportion: the body part IS the head and the body, roughly 1:1 with tiny limbs
styles.surface: true-to-material rendering, glossy or matte as the tissue implies
styles.lighting: clean clinical or soft studio light depending on the tone
styles.core_en: an anthropomorphic character made from a single body part as the entire head and body, expressive cartoon eyes and mouth placed on the tissue, tiny simple arms and legs, true-to-life material rendering of the surface, clean studio lighting, exaggerated proportions for comedic effect, surreal character design
styles.video: Very high meme potential; each new topic can be a new character.
styles.loop: Wiggle or bounce with a two-frame blink, 12 frames.

styles.tagline_en: An original invented species with lore, for channels built around world-building.
styles.tagline_zh: 原创虚构物种加设定，适合做世界观系列。
use_when: Multiple characters in one shared universe
styles.avoid_when: The channel needs one instantly understandable symbol.
styles.proportion: 1:2.5 to 1:4, distinctive silhouette, exaggerated feature
styles.surface: material mix that expresses the species biology, subtle pattern detail
styles.lighting: moody cinematic key with atmospheric fill, strong rim separation
styles.core_en: an original whimsical creature character, distinctive memorable silhouette, invented species biology with a clear signature feature, mixed organic materials and subtle skin patterning, expressive simple face, moody cinematic key light with atmospheric fill and a strong rim light for silhouette separation, painterly rendered detail, fantasy creature design
styles.video: The only lane that rewards a full cast and a buildable universe.
styles.loop: Breathe cycle with secondary motion in tail or antennae, 24 frames.

styles.tagline_en: Presenter-grade realistic human built for talking-head and live-commerce use.
styles.tagline_zh: 口播级写实真人形象，用于讲解与直播带货。
styles.avoid_when: The audience is a niche that expects illustrated or cartoon character energy.
styles.proportion: real adult human proportions, 1:7
styles.surface: realistic skin with pore and subsurface detail, natural hair strands, real fabric
styles.lighting: three-point studio lighting, soft key, catchlight in the eyes, gentle separation rim
styles.core_en: a photorealistic virtual human presenter, realistic human proportions and facial structure, detailed skin with natural pore texture and subsurface scattering, natural individual hair strands, realistic fabric clothing with fine weave detail, professional three-point studio lighting with soft key light and eye catchlights, gentle rim light for subject separation, shot on a full-frame camera with an 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field
styles.video: The presenter lane - direct address, product holding, live-selling.
styles.loop: Subtle idle: breathing, blink every 3-4s, micro head drift.

styles.tagline_en: Stylised realism - a drawn person that still reads as a real human.
styles.tagline_zh: 风格化写实：手绘感的人物，但仍像真人。
use_when: When the founder wants to appear without appearing on camera
styles.proportion: real human proportions with slight idealisation, 1:7
styles.surface: clean painterly rendering with visible brush economy, simplified skin, hair as graphic shapes
styles.lighting: simple three-quarter light, one shadow side, soft gradient
styles.core_en: a semi-realistic human illustration, real human proportions with slight idealisation, painterly rendering with visible economical brushstrokes, simplified clean skin rendering, hair treated as bold graphic shapes, simple three-quarter key light with one soft shadow side, restrained confident palette, editorial portrait illustration quality
styles.video: Good for talking-head content where real footage is not available.
styles.loop: Minimal - blink and a slight head tilt, matched to lip-sync timing.

styles.tagline_en: Human structure blended with a creature or object trait - the VTuber lane.
styles.tagline_zh: 人类结构混合生物或物件特征，即 VTuber 路线。
use_when: Anonymous hosts who still want strong recognisability
styles.avoid_when: The audience expects a plain real person.
styles.proportion: real human proportions with one or two non-human features, 1:7
styles.surface: semi-real skin with clean cel-to-soft shading blend, feature rendered in the same value range
styles.lighting: anime-style key with rim light, soft skin shading, glowing eye accents
styles.core_en: a stylised non-human virtual avatar, human facial structure blended with a non-human signature feature such as animal ears, horns or a mechanical element, realistic facial proportions, semi-realistic skin shading blended with clean anime cel shading, luminous eye accents, soft anime-style key light with a strong coloured rim light, high-detail virtual avatar render quality
styles.video: The strongest lane for live performance with full expression control.
styles.loop: Live-driven; for idle loops use blink plus a 2-frame hair sway.
